brief:
UN human rights chief Volker Türk warned Wednesday of escalating risk that Israel will commit atrocity crimes against Palestinians, citing intensified violence in the occupied West Bank in recent months, UN News reported. Türk said the violence has deepened existential fears among Palestinians.

The warning reflects mounting international concern over the humanitarian toll of Israeli military operations and settler violence in the West Bank, where Palestinians face ongoing displacement and casualties.
dek: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Wednesday warned of a widening risk of further atrocity crimes by Israel against Palestinians, saying violence in the occupied West Bank in recent months has heightened existential fears.
title: UN human rights chief warns Israel risks atrocity crimes against Palestinians
